root_track_semantics: Offline demonstration only; replicated gameplay owns world position

selection.purpose: Full-body object throw study using native ground kneeling/recovery and gait timing, two palm contacts and a neutral box fixture. Wrists are free before contact. The release trajectory is an offline demonstration, not native physics. Exact grip, object size/weight, floor contact and gameplay ownership remain to be validated.

sampling.method: offline native Edge evaluator; no entrypoint or events
